title: Game Boy Advance
description:
A 3D scene featuring the Game Boy Advance in a colorful room. You can choose game play footage from one of ten games and can control the camera speed and position. You can also customize the color of the GBA and choose between the classic model, SP model, and Micro model along with a Nintendo Switch option. The music and game box will change to match the game shown. 

The clock can also be customized with different colors and decorations.

The Classic GBA model was done by Spicy_Apples.
The models of the Game Boy Advance SP and its cartridge were created by thegraphicsgeek.
The clock model was created by igor-tkachenko.
The Mini-Mario model was created by Twilighter.
The model used for the room (Ribbon Road) was ripped from Mario Kart 8 by Ray Koopa.
The e-Reader model was ripped by Centrixe the Dodo.
The Bulbasaur doll model was ripped from Pokémon Channel by lemurboy12.
The Nintendo Switch model was ripped from Super Mario Party by DogToon64.
The Joy-Con models were ripped from Game Builder Garage by DogToon64.
The Free Cam was coded by Gariam.
I recorded the footage myself. (Hopefully I didn't play too badly!)
